title: Where I End and You Begin
author: Preston Norton
current_text: Martin County Schools banned Where I End and You Begin from libraries and classrooms in Florida in February 2023 following a formal challenge. Washington County School District banned Where I End and You Begin from libraries and classrooms in Utah in December 2022 following an informal challenge.
